variants.name: Special Alexandrite
variants.info: Uses special Alexandrite inside a .308 casing! This gem magically allows you to alter your gun performance, starting at its normal performance, then flip the switch to make it fire at half the fire rate but significantly improves recoil! Additionally, this gem also boosts your velocity significantly and the thinner nature allows you to carry 50 extra rounds in your box, but it is not so good at suppression!

variants.name: Topaz Hunter
variants.info: Uses an energetic Topaz inside a .308 casing! This gem turns your gun into a belt fed DMR, dealing very high damage especially to the torso and head capable of one shotting in the torso up close and a guaranteed kill in the head at any range! Can only carry half the magazine capacity due to the thicker round but this improves overall handling aswell!

variants.name: Amethyst Stream
variants.info: Uses pure Amethyst inside a .308 casing! Magically converts your gun into a 10 round burst rapid firing storm gun, but has a lengthy cooldown due to overheating! Comes with 2 extra boxes of ammo!

variants.name: Subsonic Ruby
variants.info: Uses the soft heavy Ruby inside a .308 casing! Due to the softer nature of this gem, your gun is now subsonic and allows it to fire insanely fast! Or can be switched to fire slower for better accuracy! Sound, suppression and radar detection are fully masked and close range damage is increased but at the cost of heavy reduction in velocity and ranged performance!

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).

variants.name: Silent
variants.info:
Experimental XM115 made for 7.62x51mm NATO firearms.

Similar functions to a flash hider, reduces sound too.

Bullet speed and suppression reduced. Works great with suppressors!

variants.name: Sapphire Edge
variants.info: Uses the sharp edges of Sapphire inside a .308 casing! Magically reduces reload time and even more if it's empty while also being semi good at penetration and never loses power over range! However it does deal less damage up close, lower velocity and requires a lower fire rate to fire safely!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Onyx Shards
variants.info: Uses a large Onyx gem inside a .308 casing! This thick stone breaks off instantly into many shards once fired, these shards are very sharp and pierce through a lot of material dealing high damage! These Onyx bullets are so thick that it requires manual rechambering and limits your box ammo quantity to only 20!

variants.name: Rare Painite
variants.info: Uses very rare Painite inside a .308 casing! This special gem truly inflicts the PAIN on your enemy by improving weapon performance and damage significantly without any visible drawbacks! However, due to how rare this gem is: you have only been able to bring 1 box of it! So if you run out, the fun is over!

variants.name: Emerald Beam
variants.info: Uses small Emerald rocks inside a .308 casing! These fly and accelerate extremely fast and nullifies all recoil to the point your gun is now a hitscan! Alongside that, doubles your magazine capacity with infinite reserve and a faster reload! However these rocks deal very little damage but ramp up a little over range!

variants.name: Quartz Storm
variants.info: Uses brittle Quartz inside a .308 casing! Easily breaks off when fired, resulting in 3 pieces flying wild and falls straight down like a brick at range! Very deadly damage up close but falls off hard and is weak at range!

variants.name: Diamond Point
variants.info: Uses very sharp Diamond points inside a .308 casing! These are very powerful at penetrating deep into hard surfaces and dealing massive damage to the body and head but weak against limbs due to overpenetration and requires a lower fire rate to fire safely!
